samples.title: Thói quen đi bộ
samples.prompt: Some people support the proposal that communities should make everyday walking more convenient. Others believe practical difficulties should be addressed before it is introduced widely. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
requirementsVi: Giải thích vì sao một phía ủng hộ.
Giải thích vì sao phía kia thận trọng.
Nêu ý kiến riêng có lý do.
samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: There are different views about the proposal that communities should make everyday walking more convenient. Supporters emphasise its usefulness, while others believe that practical difficulties should be dealt with before it is introduced more widely. Both positions have reasonable concerns. In my opinion, the idea is worth supporting when those difficulties are addressed.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu hai phía và ý kiến cá nhân.

paragraphs.label: Quan điểm thứ nhất
paragraphs.text: On the one hand, supporters focus on the benefits. One important point in favour of the proposal is that people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. This is possible because a useful route to a shop or bus stop can make walking part of a journey rather than an extra task. For example, a resident can walk to a nearby market instead of taking a motorbike for a very short trip. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Quan điểm thứ hai
paragraphs.text: On the other hand, a more cautious view deserves attention. A difficulty that should not be ignored is that some routes are difficult to use. This matters because uneven paths, missing crossings and parked vehicles can create barriers. For instance, a parent with a pushchair may have to step into the road because the pavement is blocked. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích phía thận trọng thay vì chỉ nhắc tên.

paragraphs.label: Ý kiến của tôi
paragraphs.text: My own view is that the potential benefit is worth pursuing, but the conditions matter. In particular, it would be sensible to keep pavements clear and improve practical walking routes. People should be able to understand what is expected and raise difficulties before those difficulties become a reason to give up. A flexible plan is therefore more convincing than a promise that the same method will work equally well for everyone.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cân nhắc cả hai phía và đề xuất điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, one side is right to recognise the potential value, while the other is right to ask how the idea will work in practice. I support a planned and flexible approach that pursues the benefit without overlooking the people who may face difficulties.
paragraphs.noteVi: Tóm tắt cả hai, chốt quan điểm.

paragraphs.noteVi: Theo dõi chi tiêu giúp thấy nhu cầu thiết yếu; kế hoạch phải có khoảng linh hoạt cho việc phát sinh.

paragraphs.label: Quan điểm thứ hai
paragraphs.text: On the other hand, a more cautious view deserves attention. A difficulty that should not be ignored is that a strict plan can fail when unexpected costs appear. This matters because real life includes repairs, travel changes and other expenses that are hard to predict. For instance, someone may abandon a whole spending plan after paying for an urgent bicycle repair. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích phía thận trọng thay vì chỉ nhắc tên.

paragraphs.label: Ý kiến của tôi
paragraphs.text: My own view is that the potential benefit is worth pursuing, but the conditions matter. In particular, it would be sensible to use a flexible plan and review it regularly. People should be able to understand what is expected and raise difficulties before those difficulties become a reason to give up. A flexible plan is therefore more convincing than a promise that the same method will work equally well for everyone.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cân nhắc cả hai phía và đề xuất điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, one side is right to recognise the potential value, while the other is right to ask how the idea will work in practice. I support a planned and flexible approach that pursues the benefit without overlooking the people who may face difficulties.
paragraphs.noteVi: Tóm tắt cả hai, chốt quan điểm.

A flexible plan is therefore more convincing than a promise that the same method will work equally well for everyone.
